decision: Choose the local correction: literal addition stalls in all nine V2 gap trials and leaves V5 clearance 0.858-0.876 m; the selected correction traverses all nine and moves V5 near the accepted range. Literal addition also restores the singular near field: a 2-micrometre centreline perturbation changes acceleration by 1.2e12 m/s^2 and stalls the 30-second long-gap witness. The selected correction has a 1.06e-5 m/s^2 force difference and advances 38.70 m.
intermediate_note: Initial algebraic legacy+correction evaluation suffered cancellation in the singular near field; final producer uses weight*legacy+bounded. The selected final law is represented by selected_stable_correction; intermediate probe retained as diagnosis only.
